page.layout: One page of text in a single column; margin notes at the right edge (partly cut off by the neighbouring page, not transcribed as text). Below the text a faint catchword/signature line.

main_text.p: am omnibus, quibus modò judicii mica est, placituram esse, qvum in adversarii opinionem conveniat illud Augusti-ni contra duas Epistolas Pelagii lib. 3. in Fine: Qvisqvis de qvacunq; re obscura id astruit, unde hoc, quod verisi-mum, fundatissimum notissimum est, destru-at; aut corrigendus est

page.notes: The right margin shows fragments of the neighbouring page (aut, hoc, meo, bus, hom, dè p, re, rum, natu, homin, duma, uat, nos cap) which are cut off and not transcribed. The catchword "au" at the foot is partly visible and read with doubt; the final word of the column is printed "au" with a hyphen-like mark, read as "aut" with [?]. Long s rendered as plain s; the ligature-like "ꝗ" forms were read as "qv" as printed.
